title: A matching literal date and format produce DateTimeImmutable, not false

ground_truth.statement: A matching literal date and format produce DateTimeImmutable, not false. A mismatched separator produces false.

notes: Clean-room semantic contract derived from the catalog lead, not a copy of its test harness. Runtime controls distinguish successful values from rejected or absent alternatives. This is a behavior comparison, not a recommendation that every precision limitation is product policy. The clean-room literal matches the source Y-m-d format. An initial !Y-m-d variant was runtime-valid but outside the source literal precision slice; it was removed before the final measurement. Pinned-tool observations retained without widening expectations: phpstan: return.type@5; psalm: FalsableReturnStatement@5, InvalidFalsableReturnType@4; mago: falsable-return-statement@5, invalid-return-statement@5. Runtime controls pass. These are measured precision or contract-interpretation disagreements, not assertions that the tool should adopt every tested policy.
